title: Longitudinal Tourette dataset compatibility audit
data_kind: original study-level metadata and feasibility judgments only
hypothesis: At least one audited cohort documents all prerequisites for an independent-rater within-person days-to-weeks antecedent analysis with persistent-severe-adult coverage.

status_semantics.documented: Supported by inspected primary or official source
status_semantics.design_mismatch: Reported design does not provide the specified requirement
status_semantics.not_established: Inspected evidence does not establish requirement; not proof of absence
status_semantics.conditional_route: A public statement describes a request route but no authorization has been obtained
status_semantics.public_metadata_verified: Public inventory or repository metadata checked; participant file contents not inspected

cohorts.overlap_rule: Treat 2007 and 2010 reports as one overlapping Yale cohort
cohorts.narrower_candidate_question: Monthly pediatric stress associations, conditional on lawful access and timing/measurement audit

cohorts.overlap_rule: Linked EMTICS assay reports are not independent cohort replications
cohorts.narrower_candidate_question: Coarser pediatric biological associations conditional on approved access and assay-specific timestamps

cohorts.overlap_rule: Pediatric and adult strata belong to the same reported study; no pooling with infection follow-up assumed
cohorts.narrower_candidate_question: Weekly adult life-event/self-rated-tic association if lawful access is documented

cohorts.overlap_rule: Open extension and preceding laboratory RCT are linked; laboratory rating independence cannot be transferred to EMA
cohorts.narrower_candidate_question: Self-report EMA response-delay and missingness methods after separately authorized schema/data inspection

cohorts.overlap_rule: Expanded 2024 clinical report overlaps 2019 sample; NDA collection denominator differs from paper cohort denominator
cohorts.narrower_candidate_question: Developmental prognosis or ascertainment with approved controlled access

audit_result.interpretation: Full feasibility not demonstrated in this bounded audit; not evidence that suitable data exist nowhere or that antecedents are absent.
audit_result.next_decision: Prioritize a bounded adult intensive/severe-persistence protocol and schema audit; require a qualifying design/access route before participant analysis.
